Usage: pty publication-revocation <identity|install|read> [flags] --json

Enroll a private registry root or permanently reject one exact launch operation.
Installation reports current occupancy; it never stops or removes a session.
There is no clear operation. Legacy publishers do not gain this capability retroactively.

Commands:
  identity --json
  install --id <stable-id> --operation <operation> --binding <sha256> --intent <sha256> --root-id <identity> --json
  read --id <stable-id> --operation <operation> --json

Examples:
  pty publication-revocation identity --json
  pty publication-revocation read --id worker --operation revoked-start --json
